question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Reposte
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Apology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reposte"** refers to a quick, clever, or witty reply, often in response to an insult or criticism. (हाज़िरजवाबी)
 
 
• **Example:** She made a sharp reposte when her colleague tried to criticize her work.
 
 
• The word **"Apology"** means an expression of regret or sorrow for having wronged someone or caused inconvenience. (माफ़ी)
 
 
• **Example:** He offered an apology for being late to the meeting.
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym of **'Reposte'** is **'Apology.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2) Apology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Endorsement** (समर्थन): The act of publicly or officially supporting someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The company received an endorsement from a famous celebrity for their new product.
 
 

 
• **Compliment** (प्रशंसा): A polite expression of praise or admiration.
 
 
• **Example:** She blushed when he gave her a compliment on her new dress.
 
 

 
• **Confirmation** (पुष्टि): The act of verifying or establishing something as true or valid.
 
 
• **Example:** We are still waiting for confirmation of our hotel reservation.
 
 

45:Te95,

सही उत्तर है: **2) Apology**।
